name: Riu Latino - Adults Only - All Inclusive
description:
The Hotel Riu Latino is located in Condominio Costa Mujeres, one of the most exclusive areas of Cancun. If you’re thinking of taking a holiday in the Mexican Caribbean with your partner or friends, this Adults Only hotel has the perfect combination to make your stay an unforgettable experience: our exclusive 24-hour all-inclusive service, the Splash Water World water park and direct access to the Costa Mujeres beach.
This all-inclusive hotel in Cancun has more than 550 modern, spacious and comfortable rooms, which have been designed with all the amenities you can imagine to make sure you have a great stay. After getting a good night’s sleep, you can enjoy an American-style buffet breakfast followed by a refreshing dip in one of the 5 incredible outdoor pools, some of which have a swim-up bar or in-water loungers. You can also go to the area reserved for hotel guests on the beach and enjoy your favourite drink in one of the sun loungers.
If you’re looking for a fun-filled day, look no further than the Splash Water World water park and the RIU entertainment team’s activities programme, which includes shows and a nightclub, as well as a wide range of water activities such as kayaking, catamaran trips and snorkelling so you can enjoy a new experience in the waters of the Caribbean Sea. There’s no better way to relax after a busy day than a visit to the Renova Spa, which has relaxation pools, a steam room and a range of beauty treatments.
This Adults Only hotel in Costa Mujeres offers an infinite number of dining options, from the buffet restaurant with live cooking stations to the à la carte Italian, Asian and steakhouse restaurants. What’s more, you’ll also be able to enjoy snacks in the swimming pool bars and lobby bar throughout the day. You can even surprise your partner with a romantic outdoor dinner.
Discover Costa Mujeres, a jewel in the paradise of Mexico, surrounded by a beautiful coral reef with dazzling turquoise waters and endless white sand beaches. Delve into the fascinating Mayan culture and visit natural reserves such as Isla Mujeres, Isla Blanca and Holbox. description:
Catalonia Riviera Maya Hotel
Make your holiday a once-in-a-lifetime experience at the Catalonia Riviera Maya. Come stay at our all-inclusive resort, ideal for your family vacation or for a break with your partner or friends. Located in one of themost popular areas of the Yucatan Peninsula, just 20 minutes by car from Playa del Carmen. 
Reserve one of our Privileged rooms and enjoy advantages such as exclusive access to a beach area and pool and to the BLoved restaurant, with its à la carte market cuisine. Enjoy our themed restaurants, have a snack at our bars or order your favorite cocktail without leaving the pool. Relax even more in the paradise of our Alegría Spa, with an extensive hydrotherapy area, sauna and more. All this in an incomparable natural setting that will make it a holiday to remember forever. 
Choose among the more than 400 rooms at the Catalonia Riviera Maya hotel, which await you with all the comforts and a balcony or terrace with views of the resort gardens. If you dream of seeing the ocean from your bed, opt for one of our Privileged superior ocean views. You can also opt for the Privileged suite, where you will enjoy a private terrace with a small pool where you can cool off. If you come to spend your honeymoon or a couple's getaway, there is nothing better than our Privileged romance or Privileged romance deluxe rooms, both with special services such as a romantic dinner, a massage for two and a welcome with sweets and wine (for minimum stays of 4 nights).
Stay in any of our Privileged rooms and you'll enjoy all the benefits of being a Privileged guest. These include 24-hour room service, early check-in upon arrival and late check-out (subject to availability), one access per person and stay to the water area of our Alegría Spa and, best of all, access to the exclusive areas for Privileged clients of the resort. Among them, the private beach where you will find the Pure Chill Out Bar, the best place to relax with a cocktail, access to the Privileged pool and the also exclusive BLoved restaurant. In the latter you can have breakfast, lunch and dinner à la carte in a modern place with a large terrace overlooking the sea.
One of the highlights of the Catalonia Riviera Maya resort is its gastronomy, which we have taken special care of to ensure you always have plenty of options. We have 2 buffet restaurants, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and 5 themed restaurants: Mamma Mia, with the best Italian food, Adelita, with Mexican dishes, Steakville, to enjoy grilled meats and fish and Catalonia Burgers, ideal if you love burgers. Additionally, throughout the day you will find places to have whatever you fancy near our 5 pools, or by the sea. 
Do you like golf? The Catalonia Riviera Maya hotel is located in the urban complex of Puerto Aventuras, which has its own golf club where you can practice your swing. Although, to have fun, you will not need to leave the resort, since every day we have activities for all tastes, dance classes, kayak excursions, sports tournaments, etc. In addition, in our Kid's Club the little ones will have a great time with workshops specially designed for them, mini disco, group games and much more.
Give yourself a gift just for you during your vacation and come to our Alegría Spa. There, total relaxation of body and mind awaits you in the hydrotherapy circuit, the plunge pool, the steam bath, the sauna and the massage cabins. We also have a beauty salon and aesthetic treatments.
Be amazed by the impressive historical legacy of the Riviera Maya and visit its best-known jewels, such as the archaeological site of Chichén Itzá, with its famous pyramid-shaped temple. However, there are other pyramids, such as Cobá, the tallest in the Yucatan peninsula at 42 meters high. Do you dare to climb its steep stairs? The views are worth it!

description:
Dive into the luxury of Cozumel Palace, the best All-Inclusive resort in Cozumel for families, couples, and heaven for divers. If water sports are your passion, you will love everything Cozumel Palace has to offer. An ocean of fun awaits above and below the water.Your All-Inclusive Oasis
At Cozumel Palace, everything is taken care of—your only responsibility is to relax and vacation to the fullest.

name: Catalonia Yucatan Beach
description:
Catalonia Yucatán Beach Hotel
Let yourself be enchanted by the waters of the Caribbean Sea at the all-inclusive Catalonia Yucatán Beach resort. Located within the residential area of Puerto Aventuras and just 20 minutes by car from the famous Playa del Carmen. Get ready to spend unforgettable days in the heart of the Riviera Maya, surrounded by jungle nature and white sand beaches.
Feel the soft Caribbean breeze on the terrace or balcony of one of our 205 rooms. Cool off in any of the complex's 4 pools and taste the best international and Mexican food in our buffet and a la carte restaurants. Immerse yourself in a world of sensations at the Alegría Spa, with 1,500 m2, and have fun with the best daytime and nighttime leisure activities at the Catalonia Yucatán Beach hotel.
The Catalonia Yucatán Beach hotel has been inspired by the Caribbean paradise to offer you a dream vacation. Its distribution allows all rooms to offer wonderful views, either of the sea or of the outdoor vegetation, from the terrace or balcony. If you want to ensure an incredible panoramic view of the Caribbean Sea, book our premium ocean front room.
Strolling through the formidable gardens of the resort you will arrive at our outdoor pools, a total of 4 distributed throughout the complex and 2 of them with a swim-up bar so that you can swim closer and enjoy a mojito or a beer without having to get out of the water. If you feel like a snack without wandering too far from your sun lounger, head over to Bamboleo, where you'll find bites like pizzas, salads, or pasta.
At Catalonia, we never skip breakfast—it's the most important meal of the day! That’s why at the Catalonia Yucatán Beach resort, you can enjoy our spectacular buffet, El Mercado. Choose from sweet and savory breakfast options with a live cooking station: order eggs to your liking, omelets, pancakes, and crepes. Additionally, El Mercado also offers lunch and dinner service with a wide variety of international and Mexican cuisine.
If you prefer lunch or dinner à la carte, you can choose between Mamma Mia restaurant, which serves Italian dishes such as pastas and carpaccios; the Adelita Mexican restaurant, where you can taste local cuisine such as flank steak tacos or the famous cochinita pibil and, for something more informal, the Catalonia Burgers restaurant awaits you with the best hamburgers.
Before dinner, have a drink at our T-Bar, or enjoy your favorite sporting events on the big screen in the Sports Bar. Keep the nighttime fun going with music, dancing and lots of partying at Piñata Night Club.
If truly relaxing vacations are your thing, put the finishing touch on them at our Alegría Spa. An incredible 1,500 m2 space where you will find a gym with yoga and Pilates classes, an immersion pool, a hydrotherapy circuit with water jets, a steam bath, and cabins for individual or couples massages.
If you prefer a more active holiday, our team organizes all kinds of daily activities for all ages, from water sports, aquagym in the pool or crafts, to petanque, folk dance classes and javelin shooting. In addition, you can practice your swing at the nearby golf courses (at an additional cost).
The privileged location of the Catalonia Yucatán Beach hotel guarantees that you can make the most of your stay in the Riviera Maya. Just 20 minutes by car from the bustling Playa del Carmen and just over half an hour from the Mayan ruins of Tulum, along with the famous Playa Paraíso. You can also swim with sea turtles in Akumal or visit the Sian Káan Biosphere Reserve and take a descent through its mangroves.

description: When the resort grounds are as stunning as the beach it sits on, the hardest decision you will have to make is where to spend your day. There’s entertainment for everyone in the family. name: Beach Palace Family Resort & SPA
description: Unparalleled service and signature amenities, that's what sets the stage for an exceptional All-Inclusive vacation in Cancun. At Beach Palace, you will find luxurious accommodations, 24-hour room service, world-class dining, high-speed Wi-Fi, in-room double whirlpool tubs, and much more. And the best part? It's all included!

name: Occidental Tucancun
description:
The Occidental Tucancún Hotel, a 4-star holiday resort, is situated on a beautiful Caribbean beach with white sand and crystal-clear waters, just a few kilometres from the vibrant and welcoming city of Cancún. With 339 fully equipped rooms and suites, it is one of the best all-inclusive hotels in Cancún. The hotel offers comprehensive services and impressive views of the Caribbean Sea and Nichupté Lagoon. Additionally, guests who wish to explore the surroundings can discover the nearby, perfectly preserved Mayan ruins at the El Rey archaeological site. 
Relax and enjoy an all-inclusive experience at the Occidental Tucancún hotel.
The hotel offers guests a wide variety of dining options to satisfy all tastes, including a full international buffet and three à la carte restaurants serving exquisite seafood dishes, as well as a wide range of Italian and Mexican delicacies for those seeking to savour local cuisine. 
 Additionally, this Cancún hotel features an exclusive Wellness Centre offering an extensive range of relaxing and rejuvenating treatments. It also boasts one of the most comprehensive all-inclusive services in Cancún, which includes unlimited access to refreshing drinks and cocktails at the bars, as well as free access to fun sports activities.
 With its extensive array of services, the Occidental Tucancún hotel provides guests with hospitality and all the comforts needed for a completely relaxed and worry-free holiday. What better way to imagine a perfect holiday in Cancún than to relax while enjoying a delicious tropical cocktail?

name: Paradisus Playa del Carmen-Riviera Maya-AI
description:
Welcome to a little corner of paradise. Located in an incredible mangrove forest very near huge beaches with fine, white sand, this all-inclusive luxury resort guarantees a truly unique stay. Rooms you will love with a sophisticated design and meticulous attention to even the tiniest details. Fun under the Caribbean sun in the pools and water parks for the whole family. A world of flavors in every dish. And a selection of activities that will enrich your spirit and introduce you to the splendor of Mexican culture.
Adventure, nature, relaxation... Paradisus Playa del Carmen opens the doors to everything you would like to experience during your stay in Riviera Maya. Beaches, coral reefs, crystal-clear cenote pools and inspiring Mayan ruins await you in nearby Playa del Carmen. Discover the exclusive services and benefits for Family Concierge guests designed for the whole family. Amazing and varied dining experiences in its restaurants and bars. Find the time to improve both your body and soul in the YHI Spa, a temple of well-being. Kids will also enjoy endless adventures and take part in exciting games and experiments that stimulate their curiosity and imagination.

name: Occidental Costa Cancún
description:
The 4-star Occidental Costa Cancún hotel, part of the prestigious Barceló Hotel Group, is strategically located on the famous Kukulcán Boulevard, in front of the stunning Caribbean Sea. With its privileged view of the beach "Playa Linda", it stands as an ideal holiday destination where visitors can experience maximum relaxation in an incomparable setting. The hotel is characterised by its compromise with quality, as well as by the comprehensive All Inclusive Barceló program it offers, ensuring that every guest enjoys the services and facilities to the fullest.
 
The Occidental Costa Cancún hotel offers everything you need

The 358 rooms of the hotel, with Mediterranean décor, guarantee that each stay is a unique and comfortable experience. In addition, the 4 high quality restaurants at the Occidental Costa Cancún hotel ensure a varied and delicious culinary offer. There is also a welcoming Lobby bar that is perfect for relaxing with a drink while enjoying live music.
 
The hotel offers a wide range of facilities and services, including an impressing swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, a luxurious spa, an exciting daytime and evening activities programme and a fun kids' club for children. And for guests looking for even more fun and adventure, there are also exciting watersports available.

name: The Riviera Maya EDITION at Kanai
description: The Riviera Maya EDITION at Kanai is open and receiving reservations. This luxury resort, one of the premier luxury hotels in Riviera Maya Kanai, sits on a 620-acre nature reserve with two miles of pristine white-sand beaches and rises from a forest of mangroves and tropical flora. Introducing a new concept of sustainable luxury to the Caribbean coastline, it offers 182 guest rooms and suites, a lagoon-sized pool, versatile meeting spaces, and North America's largest penthouse suite. Perfect for those seeking beachfront resorts in Playa del Carmen, Mexico or Riviera Maya luxury accommodations on the beach, Mexico's first EDITION blends modern and ancient Yucatan culture. Designed with a minimal environmental footprint to protect Kanai's ecosystem, this ancient Mayan land truly delivers on its name—Paradise on Earth.

name: Iberostar Waves Paraiso del Mar All Inclusive
description: Imagine landing in a place where every sight is a feast for your eyes. Surrounded by gardens galore. Three pools beyond a long stretch of beach. A shopping center you don’t have to leave the resort for. And Balinese beds wrapped in gorgeous Bougainvillea to laze the days away in, on a quiet, pool surrounded island. And that’s just the tip of the Paraiso del Mar iceberg.

description: The magnificent Punta Maroma beach lends its name to the Catalonia Playa Maroma, ideally situated in the Caribbean. Surrounded by lush mangroves characteristic of the Yucatan jungle, this beautiful hotel offers a surprising landscape, perfect for a relaxing holiday or exciting excursions. Spend a day on the stunning white sand beach with turquoise waters, and the next swimming with dolphins. Located on Maroma Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best, the hotel boasts soft white sand mixed with a thin layer of pink coral, ensuring a comfortable barefoot stroll along the shore.

name: Catalonia Royal Tulum All Inclusive
description:
You have just found the oasis of peace you need for your holidays at the Catalonia Royal Tulum – Adults Only hotel. Our all-inclusive resort stands in the middle of the Mexican jungle, on one of the most beautiful beaches of the Riviera Maya, Xpu-Ha. The perfect place to truly unwind among mangroves, cenotes and the picture-perfect waters of the Caribbean Sea. It boasts a privileged location, just 20 minutes from Playa del Carmen by car and 30 minutes from the Tulum ruins. 
Relax in the outdoor jacuzzis and order your favourite cocktails at the swim-up bar in our large central pool. Look after body and mind at the Alegría Spa and enjoy the gastronomy in our variety of buffet and themed restaurants and bars. Reserving one of our Privileged rooms will give you exclusive advantages and discounts, such as access to thePrivileged BLoved restaurant on the beachfront with incredible views over the Caribbean Sea. 
Come and discover the amazing Xpu-Ha beach, a long white strip that stretches for three kilometers between Tulum and Playa del Carmen. One of the best in the region, with powder-fine sand and famous for its turquoise waters among tourists and locals. Here is the fabulous Catalonia Royal Tulum – Adults only resort, which holds the prestigious 4 Diamonds certification from the American Automobile Association. This recognizes the quality of the hotel's facilities, its high level of comfort, and highlights both its design and carefully curated decor.
Can you imagine spending your honeymoon in paradise? Make it a reality in one of our Privileged Romance rooms, which have a very special design with romantic motifs, a king-size bed and extra services such as dinner on the beach for two or a couples massage (for a minimum stay of 4 nights). We also have other types of rooms, ideal for your vacations, such as the premium or the Privileged deluxe, all with a terrace or balcony so you can relax feeling the pleasant Caribbean breeze.
Also, if you book one of our Privileged rooms you will enjoy great benefits that will make your stay even more comfortable. These include early check-in and late check-out (subject to availability), pillow menu in the room, unlimited access to the Privileged BLoved restaurant, on the beachfront with sea views and breakfast, lunch and dinner service. to the letter. As well as the BLoved Bar, located in a private beach area for Privileged clients only.
If you don't want to interrupt your exercise routine during your vacation, come train in our gym while admiring the sea views or practice your swing at the golf courses near the resort. If you prefer to relax, our Alegría Spa awaits you with a water circuit, sauna, steam bath, jacuzzi and showers. If you are a Privileged guest you will have free access to the spa per person and per stay.
Celebrate a very special wedding in our facilities with a symbolic Mayan ceremony led by an authentic shaman who will bless you in his native language while you exchange your vows, accompanied by pre-Hispanic songs played live in the background. A unique moment that you will both treasure forever.
At the Catalonia Royal Tulum – Adults Only hotel we organize all kinds of daytime and nighttime entertainment so that you can have the most fun during your vacation. However, you can also choose to take excursions outside the complex to some of the wonders of the Riviera Maya such as sailing to the nearby Isla Cozumel, having adventures in the Xcaret and Xel-Há theme parks or visiting the ruins of the ancient city of Tulum. .

name: Fiesta Inn Playa del Carmen
description:
At Fiesta Inn Playa del Carmen, we’ve thought of everything to provide you with a restful, relaxing stay. Disconnect from the daily routine and enjoy your visit to the fullest at our hotel in Playa del Carmen.
Enjoy easy access to the best of the area; our hotel is located on the corner of Avenida 10 and Calle 26 in the heart of the city, just one block from the famous Quinta Avenida; famous beach clubs including Mamitas Beach, Coralina and Martina are steps away.
Unwind in our rooms after a fun-filled day. Enjoy delicious dining at La Isla – or if you’d rather not go out, order 24-hour room service. Work out in the gym, swim in our two pools, have a drink on the terrace or relax in the garden. Take care of items on your to-do list at B-ON or in the Business Center.

name: Melia Casa Maya Cancun All Inclsuive
description:
Located alongside one of the most beautiful beaches in Cancun, this all-inclusive resort is ideal for families. It offers suites with ocean views, a water park, activities for all ages and an environment that combines the Caribbean and Mayan culture for an unforgettable vacation.
Enjoy the authentic flavors in its bars and restaurants, discover the local culture through cultural experiences that enrich every moment, and create special memories with the people you love most. And if you want to take your experience to the next level, The Level rooms offer exclusive services and personalized attention in a sophisticated ambience, ideal for relaxing and being pampered.

name: Dreams Puerto Morelos Resort & Spa
description: Nestled between the vibrant jungle and the turquoise Caribbean Sea, Dreams Puerto Morelos Resort & Spa is a refined all-inclusive haven where modern comfort meets timeless heritage. Located on the serene shores of Bahía Petempich—just 20 minutes from Cancún International Airport—this coastal retreat offers a balance of adventure and relaxation, perfect for families, couples, multigenerational travelers, and wedding celebrations. Rooted in the cultural soul of the Riviera Maya, Dreams Puerto Morelos Resort & Spa draws inspiration from the natural beauty and spiritual energy of its surroundings. Here, every element of the Unlimited-Luxury® experience is designed to foster meaningful moments—from world-class cuisine and top-shelf beverages to elevated service and immersive activities. Guests can unwind across nine sparkling pools, indulge in gourmet à la carte dining, and explore lush gardens and ocean vistas from elegantly appointed suites. Kids discover wonder at the Explorer’s Club and water park, while adults enjoy serene spa treatments, lively entertainment, and the exclusivity of the Preferred Club. Whether you’re reconnecting with loved ones or celebrating life’s milestones, Dreams Puerto Morelos Resort & Spa is where unforgettable memories begin. Born in nature, rooted in meaning.

The spectacular beauty of Cancun is best enjoyed at Fiesta Americana Cancun Villas, located in the heart of the Hotel Zone. Make the vacation of your dreams come true at this resort that perfectly combines traditional Mexican hospitality with modern spaces and unparalleled amenities.
As one of the top options for villa rentals in Cancun México, this resort offers spacious rooms, villas, and suites that provide a relaxed atmosphere, ideal for sharing pleasant moments with your family. description:
Magic on the Riviera Maya
Relax and unwind in a spectacularly spacious, architect-designed Cancun villa. Bask in the luxury of private beach access, rejuvenating spa experiences, your own home theatre, sauna, steam room and more. Escape to this enchanting retreat and redefine your perception of paradise. name: Margaritaville Island Reserve Riviera Maya
description: Encompassing upscale coastal design, exceptional service, and top-quality food and beverage, Margaritaville® Island Reserve Riviera Maya delivers a vibrant, world-class Island Reserve Inclusive® experience. Travelers will enjoy a carefree, fun vacation, inspired by the lyrics and lifestyle of singer, songwriter and bestselling author Jimmy Buffett. The resort is the perfect setting for guests to get away from their daily routines and enjoy total relaxation. Margaritaville® Island Reserve Riviera Maya offers an incomparable resort setting with its unique, authentic, “no worries,” tropical vibe and the feeling of escapism that is experienced immediately upon arrival. This impressive complex has 765 rooms and suites surrounded by beautiful jungle gardens with a terrace or balcony. It also boasts riverbed formations, 7 swimming pools, and a private cove with soft white sand and tropical palm trees.  The hotel's dining options include 11 bars and 11 restaurants to suit all tastes. Minimum Age Requirements: The minimum legal age for hotel check-in is 18 years old. Each room must include at least one occupant who is 18 years of age or older.
Minors Aged 17 Traveling Without a Legal Parent or Guardian: Guests who are 17 years of age and traveling without their legal parent or guardian must present written and signed consent from their legal parent or guardian upon check-in at the hotel. name: JW Marriott Cancun Resort & Spa
description: Indulge in a revitalizing retreat at one of the best luxury hotels in Cancun, Mexico, JW Marriott Cancun Resort and Spa where you will discover personalized services, modern rooms with private balconies, and elegant suites that highlight the Mexican Caribbean experience. Enjoy spacious accommodations with privileged access to the most attractive destinations at our hotel in Cancun, Mexico. Explore the historical Mayan ruins nearby and experience the area's lively clubs and bars. Watch the sunrise over the blue Mexican Caribbean Sea, unwind with a dip in the infinity pool, retreat to a beachfront Bali daybed or pursue a little wellness at our world-class Mayan-inspired spa Sens-yah, proudly awarded 4 stars by Forbes travel guide. Relish with our five international restaurants: Sasi Thai, Gustino Italian Grill, Bella Candela, Bravio Spanish Cuisine and La 16 Mexican Cuisine. The only thing left to do is toast to it all with creative craft cocktails offerings from the JW Lobby Bar’s 150 Margaritas Menu.

name: Margaritaville Island Reserve Riviera Cancun
description:
Inspired by the lyrics and lifestyle of Jimmy Buffett, Margaritaville®
Beach Resort, Riviera Cancun provides the perfect setting for guests who want to escape the everyday with a tropical change in latitude. Margaritaville® Beach Resort, Riviera Cancun is unique in that it has all the world- class amenities of a luxurious, all-inclusive hotel coupled with a laid-back, beachy vibe - making it the perfect place for people who value exceptional quality without any pretense. From the moment guests enter the property, they are greeted with a welcome refreshment and flip flops and are immediately transported to a seaside paradise. Whether guests want to spend the day relaxing in one of our beach hammocks, partaking in margarita inspired spa treatments, or celebrating that it’s always 5 o’Clock somewhere with a poolside margarita, there are unique, authentic experiences for all. With exceptional Island Reserve Inclusive restaurants, specialty bars, and daily live music, Margaritaville® Beach Resort, Riviera Cancun is a place to raise a glass and take a bite out of paradise. Guests can enjoy meals with the utmost confidence in knowing that a team of expert chefs are prepared to cater to all dietary requirements throughout each and every dining experience. With all the hustle and bustle of everyday life, Margaritaville® grants guests a license to chill, relax and unwind. By the end of their stay, guests will leave feeling refreshed, rejuvenated, and daydreaming about their next stay in paradise. Resort highlights include Rita’s Taco House, serving traditional Mexican fare with phenomenal ocean views, S.O.S. (Stranded on a Sand Bar) Swim Up Bar complete with hanging beds, Blended where guests can whip up their favorite fresh fruit on a bike blender or the oceanfront, adults-only License to Chill Bar, for a relaxing day lounging beachside. Our St. Somewhere Spa, with over 8,000 square feet of treatment areas, offers guests the chance to delight in tropical-inspired treatments which take relaxation to the next level. The property’s intimate size plays a major role in providing an experience which encompasses a thoughtful expression of the Margaritaville® essence with plenty of space to seek refuge. A team of Island Ambassadors will ensure that every guest’s vacation is entertaining and memorable. A concierge, vacation-planner and catalyst for fun, these experts are on-call to answer questions, take requests and to make guests smile throughout their stay.

name: Excellence Riviera Cancun
description: Excellence is the word that describes this magnificent adults only resort, situated right on a lovely beach of the Mexican's coast, between the vibrant city of Cancun and the beautiful Playa del Carmen. Cancun International Airport is only a 20-minute drive away and the staff of the hotel might help guests to arrange transport service. All the accommodation units offer a little world of luxury featuring top-notch amenities to provide an unforgettable stay in Riviera Maya. The establishment boasts an incredible range of dining and wining options, offering exquisite international cuisine in different types of ambiances. Guests can enjoy many activities and leisure options, such as volleyball or tennis, and spend relaxing moments in the exclusive wellness area or at one of the many swimming pools available in the resort. Those who choose to stay in this accommodation will live a unique holiday experience.

name: Iberostar Selection Riviera Cancun
description: Ready for a unique experience in the Caribbean? Welcome to the Iberostar Selection Riviera Cancún, an all-inclusive resort located just 20 minutes from the airport and very close to the fishing village of Puerto Morelos. Designed to help you unwind as a couple or as a family, it features 5 pools, spacious suites—including our exclusive Swim-Up Suites with direct access to a semiprivate swimming pool—and varied and conscious dining options at 6 restaurants and 4 bars. Are you up for starting the day with a snorkeling session? Explore the ocean, practice water sports, relax with a massage, or play a game of tennis. In the meantime, the little ones will have a great time at our Star Camp—a program full of activities adapted for different age groups. And all this with a commitment to respect and care for the oceans.

name: Excellence Playa Mujeres
description: Indulge in a luxurious escape at the 5-star Excellence Playa Mujeres - Adults Only All Inclusive, nestled in the serene Playa Mujeres area of Punta Sam. Just a short drive from Mujeres Beach and the Punta Sam Ferry Terminal, this all-inclusive property offers a wealth of amenities. Pamper yourself at the spa with massages, body treatments, and facials, or unwind by one of the seven outdoor swimming pools or on the private beach. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services and gift shops. Each of the 450 guestrooms boasts a private furnished balcony or patio, a free minibar, an LED television with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with a jetted bathtub and separate shower. Savor international cuisine at Toscana, one of the ten on-site restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Refreshments are available at the coffee shop, beach bar, eleven bars/lounges, and seven poolside bars. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and free valet parking.

name: Fiesta Inn Cancun Las Americas
description: Located in the Malecon Américas commercial district, the accommodation establishment offers easy access to a wide range of popular restaurants and bars, including Sushi Itto, Liverpool, Starbucks Coffee and Chilis. The bus station is approximately 1 km and the beach about 15 km from the hotel. This city hotel is situated in a shopping area inside Malecon Américas and comprises a total of 152 guest rooms. A range of spacious and comfortable multi-purpose rooms for private work sessions, meetings and other group events are also available to guests. Accommodation units offer wireless Internet access and a flat-screen cable TV.

description: A SPARKLING CARIBBEAN JEWEL/nMake your entrance in one of the most desirable locations in all of Cancún. Breathe in the ocean air. Sway in a balcony hammock. Soak up the sun and scene at Bungalow Beach Club. Treat yourself at the spa. Take a swing at 18 holes. Recharge in a gorgeous suite.
